verdict.rationale: Docusign Web Forms provides its own guided questionnaire capability: drag-and-drop forms with conditional logic, plus AI conversion of PDFs and templates into guided flows. Separately, CLM and AI-Assisted Review flag risky or non-compliant clauses against playbooks. However, the flagging reviews agreement language, not questionnaire answers, and nothing shows the form flow itself marks choices for attorney review. missing for 10: a ready-made founder-oriented legal document library with answer-driven correctness, flagging of questionnaire choices that need attorney review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
